Synthetic regular image files for USB-Recovery; no personal data or third-party executable binaries. Filesystem metadata was created by e2fsprogs 1.47.3. The original journal-* cases use manual journal records. The native-journal-* cases use debugfs journal_open/journal_write with commands and hashes in manifest.json; explicitly named corruption and ring relocation controls derive from those bytes. No filesystem was mounted and no physical device was scanned. This provenance file does not grant a separate license.
